name: Sony BRAVIA XBR-55X850C
summary: Sony BRAVIA XBR-55X850C has a viewing tracker, promo rows and preloaded apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This 2015 Sony runs Android TV 8.0 and ships with Samba TV, which tracks what is on screen. It also has Sony device and remote-support agents, Sony Select promos, a Discover content bar, recommendation rows, and automatic installs of partner apps. Preloaded help tiles, manuals, games and streaming apps add to the clutter.

Nothing was disabled at the factory. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. After the change the Inputs list still showed HDMI, Video and Live TV, and the Input button still worked.
keep: Live TV and input app, which also plays every HDMI input
Sony's keyboard, settings and software updates
Hotel mode plumbing, Sony IP control and DLNA
notes: Turning off the launcher customizer removes the notification, Inputs and Timer icons from the top bar of the stock home. The remote's Input button still works.
The list turns off Google Assistant by the owner's choice, which removes the remote's mic search.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Sony XBR-55X850C?
faq.a: Not with this list. The owner turned off Google Assistant, which removes the remote's mic search. You can switch it back on in the app.
Yes. The Live TV app that plays every HDMI input is kept, along with HDMI-CEC.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the stock Android TV home screen back.
